plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that in 2024 a man named Matthew Brown told him he had figured out Immaculate Constellation, said to be a hidden US government program about UFOs, and that the name of Lue Elizondo, a former official from a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, was tied to it. According to Michels, Elizondo then testified alongside the journalist Michael Shellenberger and said he could not confirm or deny whether he had been given access to it. If true, it would mean a secret program exists that even its public figures will not openly discuss.
